page.overview:
Who is Franco Colapinto?

Franco Alejandro Colapinto (born 27 May 2003) is an Argentine racing driver currently competing in the Formula 1 for Alpine.

A member of the Williams Driver Academy 2023 to 2024, Colapinto made his Formula One debut at the Italian Grand Prix, replacing Logan Sargeant for the remainder of the as an interim for the incoming Carlos Sainz Jr. With his debut, he became the first Argentine driver to compete in Formula One since Gastón Mazzacane in 2001. Colapinto scored his maiden points finish at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix. He joined Alpine as a reserve driver for and was promoted to a race seat after six Grands Prix in the season, replacing Jack Doohan.

Colapinto replaced Logan Sargeant at Williams after the Dutch Grand Prix and will compete for Williams for the remainder of the 2024 being set to debut at the Italian Grand Prix. Colapinto is the first Formula One driver from Argentina since Gastón Mazzacane, who last raced in 2001.

At debut, Colapinto but recovered to twelfth. The following race at Azerbaijan Grand Prix, Colapinto finished eighth, making him the first Argentine to score points in Formula One since Carlos Reutemann at the 1982 South African Grand Prix (although Mazzacane would have scored at the 2000 Italian Grand Prix under the modern-day scoring system). At Singapore Grand Prix, he finished eleventh and received praise from Sergio Pérez for his sturdy defense.
